## Warranty

Provider (id + name), kind (manufacturer / extended / service-contract / none), startsOn / endsOn, terms and a claim reference. `isActive` and `daysRemaining` are computed on **calendar days** (never `toISOString`) so boundary days are right in every timezone.

The field's job: say *“covered until 2027-03-14 — claim, don't pay”* before a technician orders a part. The Work Order shows that banner while `isActive`.

Generic: an asset, a laptop, a vehicle, a building system. FieldDefs cannot `linksTo`, so the provider is stamped as id + name; the consuming card may also link the Vendor.
